en.title: Product Reveal Animation and Launch Video Examples
en.description: Fourteen product reveal animation recipes from launch films: light reveal, macro pull-out, x-ray, lens flare, exploded view and more, built with HyperFrames.
en.h1: Product reveal examples from launch films
en.lede: A product reveal is the shot where a launch video first shows the product. These fourteen recipes cover light reveals, macro pull-outs, x-ray dissolves, accessory line-ups, fluted glass, dolly zoom, light beams, lens flare, count-up numbers, rack focus and exploded views, taken from product launch videos. Each film runs 10 to 12 seconds at 1920x1080, is built in code with HyperFrames and is shown next to the original clip, with camera and timing numbers for every move.

blocks.text: Where a product reveal sits in a launch video

The reveal usually opens the film or follows a short macro sequence. Light Reveal starts with a rim light at 0 s and has the product fully visible at 1.6 s. Macro Pull-out Reveal spends 4.8 s on three close-up shots before one pull-back at 4.8 to 6.0 s shows the whole page.

Several recipes end the reveal on a wordmark. Light Reveal brings the wordmark in at 8.78 s, and Outline to Solid Reveal follows the product shot with a short logo version. For logo endings in detail, see [logo animation](/logo-animation/). For the scene changes that follow a reveal, see [transitions](/transitions/).

Three more recipes reveal the product with the lens or with light. Fluted Glass Effect raises light streaks through ribbed glass on a laptop screen until they form a big word, then pushes in while the glass flattens and the title sharpens. Dolly Zoom Effect backs the camera away as the lens zooms in, so a phone holds its size and the hall behind it flattens into a dashboard. Light Beam Effect has laptops throw trapezoid beams of light that each reveal an app screen, hand off between laptops and carry a stat along one edge.

Four more recipes reveal the product with a flare, a number, a focus pull or a teardown. Lens Flare Effect sweeps a long blue streak with a chain of ghost rings across a smartwatch on black, then raises the title. Count Up Animation rolls a huge number up digit by digit and repeats the move in a dashboard card with a line drawing in step. Rack Focus pulls focus from a foreground insight card to the laptop dashboard behind it, then onto the headline. Exploded View Animation spreads a phone's seven layers apart with callouts, dives the camera onto the logic board, then closes the stack and lands on the lockup.
The 14 product reveal recipes

items: [Light Reveal](/recipes/light-reveal/): The product fades up from black in 1.2 s with a barely perceptible push, holds 2.8 s, shows three colorways, and fades out in reverse at the end.

[Device Push-in Focus](/recipes/device-push-in-focus/): A line-art 3D laptop turns upright while closed, opens in 0.55 s, pushes in on the keyboard over 1.6 s, then pans key to key with the option picked in the UI.

[Macro Pull-out Reveal](/recipes/macro-pull-out-reveal/): The camera drifts across a chart, a deployment row and a button at extreme close range for 4.8 s, then one 1.2 s pull-back reveals the whole page.
[X-Ray Effect](/recipes/x-ray-effect/): Macro shots of a chip and a board cross-dissolve to the outer shell on one camera position, then the camera pulls back to the whole device in 1.2 s.
[Text–Object Interleave](/recipes/text-object-interleave/): The product lights up, sinks, and the wordmark rises from behind it over 1.8 s; later a device drops into a gap in a sentence in 0.5 s.
[Dispense Line-up](/recipes/dispense-line-up/): Accessories slide out of the main object 0.15 s apart into a row, hold 1.1 s and retract in mirrored order while the caption appears word by word.
[Outline-to-Solid Reveal](/recipes/outline-to-solid-reveal/): A light point draws the outline over 3 s, the solid body fades in 1.5 s, a highlight sweeps across, and a slow push follows until 8.2 s.
[Fluted Glass Effect](/recipes/fluted-glass-effect/): Light streaks rise through ribbed glass on a laptop screen and form a big word; the camera pushes in, the glass flattens and the title sharpens.
[Dolly Zoom Effect](/recipes/dolly-zoom-effect/): The camera backs away as the lens zooms in: a phone holds its size and the hall behind it flattens into a dashboard.
[Light Beam Effect](/recipes/light-beam-effect/): Laptops throw trapezoid beams of light that reveal app screens, hand off to each other and carry a stat along one edge.
[Lens Flare Effect](/recipes/lens-flare-effect/): A long blue flare with chromatic ghost rings sweeps across a smartwatch on black, then the title rises and a smaller flare crosses it.

[Count Up Animation](/recipes/count-up-animation/): A huge number rolls up digit by digit, fast at first and slowing onto its target, then the same move runs in a dashboard card with a line drawing in step.
[Rack Focus](/recipes/rack-focus/): Focus pulls from a foreground card to the laptop behind it, a second card slides in and takes focus back, and a last pull lands on the headline.
[Exploded View Animation](/recipes/exploded-view-animation/): A phone's seven layers spread apart with callouts, the camera dives onto the logic board, then the stack closes and lands on the lockup.

blocks.text: How to make these with Claude Code or Codex
Install the Motionboard skill in Claude Code or Codex. Then paste the copy prompt from a recipe page, or ask the skill for a recipe by name and give it your product, logo and brand colors.
npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard

The agent recreates the shot for your own product. Copy one recipe, or ask the skill for a whole film built from several. The output is an MP4 rendered with HyperFrames, or GSAP motion that runs on your website. The [product launch video guide](/guides/product-launch-video-with-claude-code/) covers the full workflow.

items: What is a product reveal animation?

A product reveal animation is the shot that first shows a product in a launch video, using light, camera movement or object motion. These recipes reveal a phone with light, a device by pulling the camera back, and a laptop by opening it and pushing in on the keys.
How long should a product reveal take?

The reveal move itself is short, and the hold that follows is longer. Light Reveal fades up in 1.2 s and holds 2.8 s, Macro Pull-out Reveal pulls back in 1.2 s, and X-ray Effect pulls back in 1.2 s. Most of the film is the lead-in and the hold.
How do I make a product launch video with Claude Code?

Install the Motionboard skill, give the agent your product visuals and a recipe name, and it builds a HyperFrames composition that renders to MP4. The product launch video guide linked above walks through the steps from recipe to final render.

zh.title: 产品揭示动画与发布视频示例
zh.description: 14 个来自发布片的产品揭示动画配方，包括光线揭示、微距拉出、X 光透视、棱镜玻璃、镜头光晕、爆炸图等，用 HyperFrames 写代码做出。
zh.h1: 发布片里的产品揭示示例
zh.lede: 产品揭示是发布视频第一次展示产品的镜头。这 14 个配方来自产品发布视频，覆盖光线揭示、微距拉出、X 光叠化、配件排列、棱镜玻璃、希区柯克变焦、光束、镜头光晕、数字滚动、拉焦和爆炸图。每个都是用 HyperFrames 写代码做出的 10 到 12 秒 1920x1080 短片，旁边附上原片，并标出每个运镜和动作的时间数据。

blocks.text: 产品揭示在发布视频里的位置
揭示通常放在片子开头，或接在一小段微距镜头之后。光线揭示在 0 秒打开轮廓光，1.6 秒时产品完全可见。微距拉出揭示先用 4.8 秒拍三个近景，再在 4.8 到 6.0 秒用一次后拉交代出整页。
有几个配方以字标收尾揭示。光线揭示在 8.78 秒进入字标，描边转实心揭示在产品镜头之后接一个简短的 logo 版本。Logo 收尾的细节见 [Logo 动画](/logo-animation/)，揭示之后的场景切换见[转场](/transitions/)。
另有三个配方用镜头或光来揭示产品。棱镜玻璃效果让光带穿过笔记本屏幕上的棱纹玻璃，聚成一个大字，随后镜头推近，玻璃变平，标题变清晰。希区柯克变焦效果在镜头后退的同时把焦距推近，手机大小不变，身后的大厅被压平成一个仪表盘。光束效果让笔记本投出梯形光束，每道光束里显示一个应用界面，光束在笔记本之间交接，并沿一条边带出一个数据。
另有四个配方用光晕、数字、拉焦或拆解来揭示产品。镜头光晕效果让一道细长的蓝色光晕带着一串鬼影圆环扫过黑场里的智能手表，随后标题升起。数字滚动动画让一个很大的数字一位一位向上滚，再把同一个手法放进仪表盘卡片，折线随数字同步画出。拉焦让焦点从前景的洞察卡片拉到后面笔记本上的仪表盘，再拉到标题。爆炸图动画把手机的七层结构分开并配上标注，镜头扎向逻辑板，随后叠层合拢，落在字标上。
14 个产品揭示配方

items: [暗场打光显影](/recipes/light-reveal/)：产品在 1.2 秒内从黑场亮起，伴随极轻的推近，停留 2.8 秒，展示三种配色，结尾再反向熄灭。
[设备推镜聚焦](/recipes/device-push-in-focus/)：线稿风 3D 笔记本合盖转正，用 0.55 秒开盖，在 1.6 秒内推近键盘，再随界面里选中的选项逐个平移到对应按键。
[微距拉远揭示](/recipes/macro-pull-out-reveal/)：镜头用 4.8 秒贴着图表、部署条目和按钮超近距离慢移，随后一次 1.2 秒的后拉交代出整页。
[X 光透视效果](/recipes/x-ray-effect/)：芯片和主板的微距镜头在同一机位叠化成外壳，随后镜头用 1.2 秒拉远成整机。
[文字穿插实物效果](/recipes/text-object-interleave/)：产品亮起后下沉，字标在 1.8 秒内从它后面升起；之后一台设备在 0.5 秒内落入句子中的空位。
[配件依次滑出排列动画](/recipes/dispense-line-up/)：配件从主体里以 0.15 秒的间隔逐个滑出排成一行，停留 1.1 秒后按镜像顺序收回，文案逐词同步出现。
[描边到实体显形动画](/recipes/outline-to-solid-reveal/)：光点用 3 秒勾出轮廓，实心主体用 1.5 秒淡入，一道高光扫过，之后缓慢推近到 8.2 秒。
[棱镜玻璃效果](/recipes/fluted-glass-effect/)：光带穿过笔记本屏幕上的棱纹玻璃，聚成一个大字；镜头推近，玻璃变平，标题变清晰。
[希区柯克变焦效果](/recipes/dolly-zoom-effect/)：镜头后退的同时镜头焦距推近：手机大小不变，身后的大厅被压平成一个仪表盘。
[光束效果](/recipes/light-beam-effect/)：笔记本投出梯形光束，光束里显示应用界面，彼此交接，并沿一条边带出一个数据。
[镜头光晕效果](/recipes/lens-flare-effect/)：一道细长的蓝色光晕带着色散鬼影圆环扫过黑场里的智能手表，随后标题升起，一道更小的光晕从它上面掠过。
[数字滚动动画](/recipes/count-up-animation/)：一个很大的数字一位一位向上滚，开头很快，最后慢慢落在目标数上，随后同一个手法出现在仪表盘卡片里，折线随数字同步画出。
[拉焦（焦点转移）](/recipes/rack-focus/)：焦点从前景卡片拉到后面的笔记本，第二张卡片滑入并把焦点拉回前景，最后一次拉焦落在标题上。
[爆炸图动画](/recipes/exploded-view-animation/)：手机的七层结构分开并配上标注，镜头扎向逻辑板，随后叠层合拢，落在字标上。

blocks.text: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做出这些效果
在 Claude Code 或 Codex 里安装 Motionboard skill。之后可以粘贴配方页上的复制提示词，也可以直接按名字向 skill 要一个配方，并提供你的产品、logo 和品牌色。
npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard
Agent 会按你的产品重新做出这个镜头。可以只复制一个配方，也可以让 skill 用多个配方拼成一整支片子。输出是用 HyperFrames 渲染的 MP4，或者可以直接放进网站的 GSAP 动效。完整流程见[产品发布视频指南](/guides/product-launch-video-with-claude-code/)。

items: 什么是产品揭示动画？
产品揭示动画是发布视频里第一次展示产品的镜头，借助光线、运镜或物体运动完成。这些配方用光线揭示一部手机，用后拉镜头揭示一台设备，用开盖再推近键盘的方式揭示一台笔记本。
产品揭示应该多长？
揭示动作本身很短，随后的停留更长。光线揭示用 1.2 秒亮起并停留 2.8 秒，微距拉出揭示后拉 1.2 秒，X 光透视效果的后拉也是 1.2 秒。片子的大部分时间是铺垫和停留。
怎样用 Claude Code 做产品发布视频？
安装 Motionboard skill，把产品画面和配方名交给 agent，它会生成可渲染成 MP4 的 HyperFrames 合成。上面链接的产品发布视频指南按步骤讲解从配方到最终渲染的过程。
